newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile May retail sales grow 2.5 pct vs year-ago.
newsitem.headline: Chile May retail sales grow 2.5 pct vs year-ago.

text.p: Chilean retail sales increased 2.5 percent in May compared with the same month last year and were up 2.7 percent in the first five months of the year, said the National Chamber of Commerce.
"The cumulative sales figure is far lower than the 7.8 percent recorded in the same period last year," said Raul Guzman, president of the chamber's economic committee.
Retail sales have been seriously hit by the central bank's tight monetary policy which has been in force for the last year.
Sectors with highest sales growth in May included footware, up 24 percent, household goods, up six percent and supermarket sales, which rose six percent on the same month last year.
Sales of electrical good fell 7.5 percent, while the distribution of building materials dropped 12 percent. ((-- Gabriela Donoso, Santiago newsroom, 562-699-5595 x212))
